description: Dispatches a physical click to a resolved page target.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the click target.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the click target.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID from DOM.getAXTree.

x.description: Fallback X coordinate for coordinate-based clicking.

y.description: Fallback Y coordinate for coordinate-based clicking.

force.description: Dispatch even when the resolved element is occluded. Normal browser hit testing still applies, so an overlay may receive the input. Ignored for coordinate-based clicks.

clickCount.description: Number of clicks to dispatch: 1 or 2.

purpose.description: Describe the intended effect of this click, e.g., opening a menu, selecting a result, or submitting a form

target.description: Target identity used for the click.

resolvedBy.description: Actor or resolution mode that selected the target.

recoveredTarget.description: Snapshot details used when a stale target was recovered.

point.description: CSS-pixel point used for the click.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used by the action.

observation.description: Factual observation of the completed Action and its current visible result.

suggested_prompt.description: Action-specific next-step guidance based on the returned result.

target.description: Target identity used for the click.

resolvedBy.description: Actor or resolution mode that selected the target.

recoveredTarget.description: Snapshot details used when a stale target was recovered.

point.description: CSS-pixel point used for the click.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used by the action.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Factual observation that does not expose private runtime diagnostics.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Action-specific public details; private execution diagnostics are omitted.

purposeHint: Describe the intended effect of this click, e.g., opening a menu, selecting a result, or submitting a form
